reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Serum: Retinal Liposome 2%+Black Ginseng 30ml
reviews.text: I'm already on my second bottle! I use it every night and absolutely love it. It feels super pleasant on the skin, causes no irritation, and really works. Highly recommend!
reviews.zh: 我已經用緊第二支！每晚都用，絕對愛上咗。喺皮膚上嘅感覺超級舒服，唔會造成刺激，而且真係有效。強烈推薦！

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Serum: Retinal Liposome 2%+Black Ginseng 30ml
reviews.text: I don’t use it again maybe my skin can’t compare this product
reviews.zh: 我唔會再用，可能係我嘅膚質用唔到呢個產品。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Serum: Retinal Liposome 2%+Black Ginseng 30ml
reviews.text: I’ve bought this product twice now. It’s a great alternative to retinol. It’s more affective, but also less harsh on the skin. It feels great on the skin. It’s lightweight and easily absorbs.
reviews.zh: 我已經買咗兩次。係視黃醇嘅一個好好嘅代替品。比視黃醇更有效，但對皮膚冇咁刺激。搽上皮膚感覺好好。質地輕盈，容易吸收。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Serum: Retinal Liposome 2%+Black Ginseng 30ml
reviews.text:
＼レチノール初心者さんに激推ししたい！／
K-SECRETのこれ、みずみずしくて軽いクリームのテクスチャーだから、すごく使い心地が良いの✨
💡私の使い方
•週に3日、夜のケアにプラスするだけ🌙
•これを塗った後に、保湿クリームをしっかり重ねてね！
• 翌朝は絶対に日焼け止め（サンクチュアリ）を塗るのを忘れないこと⚠️
肌なじみもよくて、使ってみて大満足！本当におすすめです🤍
reviews.zh:
＼激推畀視黃醇新手用！／
K-SECRET 呢枝，質地係水潤輕盈嘅乳霜，搽落好舒服✨
💡我嘅用法
•一個禮拜 3 日，夜晚護膚嗰陣加上去就得🌙
•搽完之後，再疊一層保濕霜！
•第二朝一定要記得搽防曬（サンクチュアリ）⚠️
同皮膚好貼，試完非常滿意！真心推薦🤍

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Serum: Retinal Liposome 2%+Black Ginseng 30ml
reviews.text: It does what it’s supposed to do. It does give you a more poreless skin. My skin got irritated a bit cos i used it two days in a row(so don’t do that). Using it 2-3 times a week would give good results.
reviews.zh: 做到佢應該做到嘅嘢。的確做到更零毛孔嘅皮膚。我連續兩日用，搞到皮膚有少少受刺激（所以唔好咁做）。一個禮拜用 2-3 次就會有好效果。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Serum: Retinal Liposome 2%+Black Ginseng 30ml
reviews.text: This serum really helps with pigmentation. I live in Israel and we really like to be exposed to the sun because we love the tan color of our skin, but the sun is also really harmful to us, so I have some pigmentation under my lips. I recently started using this serum and I'm already starting to see my pigmentation lightening. Highly recommend it, just be careful when you apply it to the pigmentation because where it's without pigmentation, it causes pimples (for me, these weren't regular pimples. They took a long time to go away)
reviews.zh: 呢支精華真係幫到手處理色素沉澱。我住喺以色列，我哋好鍾意曬太陽，因為鍾意自己曬黑嘅膚色，但太陽對我哋皮膚傷害都好大，所以我嘴唇下面有啲色斑。我啱啱開始用呢支精華，已經開始見到色斑淡咗。非常推薦，不過搽嘅時候要小心，喺冇色素沉澱嘅位置會爆瘡（對我嚟講，呢啲唔係一般嘅瘡，消得好慢）。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Serum: Retinal Liposome 2%+Black Ginseng 30ml
reviews.text:
I really like this serum! The retinal formula feels powerful but still gentle thanks to the liposome technology.
It absorbs well and doesn’t irritate my skin like some retinol products do. Over time, my skin looks smoother and more refined.
The addition of black ginseng makes it feel nourishing as well.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢支精華！retinal 配方感覺強效，但因為有 liposome 技術所以都好溫和。吸收得好，亦都唔會好似其他視黃醇產品咁刺激我嘅皮膚。用耐咗，皮膚望落更滑更細緻。加埋黑蔘，感覺都好有營養。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Serum: Retinal Liposome 2%+Black Ginseng 30ml
reviews.text: This is the second time I've ordered this series, including the eye cream. In my opinion, these are the best retinol products I've tried. I use it every night. I have no irritation or redness on my skin and the feeling is excellent. In my opinion, it made a huge difference in my facial skin.
reviews.zh: 呢個系列我已經係第二次訂，連眼霜都包括埋。我認為係我試過嘅視黃醇產品之中最好嘅。我每晚都用。皮膚冇刺激冇泛紅，感覺一流。我覺得對我塊面皮膚有好大嘅改善。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
